name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest merged PR first. It’s the fastest way to catch routing errors and quality issues in completed work before they compound. The trade-off is delayed feedback on open PRs, but merged PRs represent the highest risk of undetected flaws slipping into production.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on merged PRs is too late—it catches errors *after* they’re already in production, not before. A better alternative is running PR-Agent in shadow mode on *open* PRs first, where fixes prevent compounding flaws. Settle it by measuring the delta in post-merge incidents between the two approaches over a month.
